route_title: 6-Layer Odd-Quarter-Wave Perturbed Initialization with Enhanced Step-Size
compilation_rationale: Fixed 6-layer stack compiled from explicit sequence. Initial thicknesses derived from odd-quarter-wave optical rule centered at 250 nm, perturbed by ±15 nm on alternating layers. Bounds constrained to 20–400 nm. Gradient optimizer applies 2× learning rate to accelerate convergence. Reflectance minimized in dual bands; transmittance reported post-optimization. Uncertainty modeled as ±15 nm absolute normal distribution.
